selected_template.template_name: Lead Intake to Qualification to Follow-up

why_this_template: The workflow starts from a lead form submission.
The workflow requires validation, dedupe, lead qualification, CRM update, AI email draft, approval, and notification.
Most required core components are already built.

blocking_items.reason: Required for production HubSpot upsert testing.

next_steps: Assemble demo version of TPL-P0-001 using existing core components.
Use mock/manual handoffs for Gmail and Slack.
Request HubSpot private app token or OAuth access.
Build ADP-GMAIL-SEND before production email sending.
Build ADP-SLACK-SEND before production Slack notifications.
Run acceptance tests using dummy lead data.
handoff_notes: Do not claim Gmail/Slack live adapters are already built.
Do not auto-send external emails unless approval rules allow it.
Use existing C2-I for email notification demos where possible.
